title: Give the 0.1.0 install path an entry point: a root README and a clickable runbook URL in the Release notes
description:
Filed from WCLI-82 by the ward-cli worker on 2026-10-26, on team-lead's scope after the 0.1.0 release (ODOC-542 AC5). ODOC-542 AC5 asks that install and upgrade docs exist. They do: docs/runbooks/install-and-upgrade-ward-from-a-release.md carries the whole procedure, including the keychain re-approval after an upgrade (its step 10) and the profile re-approval after a snapshot bump (step 11). What is missing is an ENTRY POINT and a self-sufficient Release page, and those are the two acceptance criteria here.

1. The repository has no README at all. Someone arriving at opum-ai/ward-cli finds a docs/ tree with no front door, and nothing that says what Ward is, what the one-line install is, or which document to read first. The README lands in the change that files this task: three lines of install naming the v0.1.0 Release and linking the runbook.

2. The Release notes generated by .github/workflows/release.yml print the install path as the bare text "docs/runbooks/install-and-upgrade-ward-from-a-release.md". On a Release page that is not a link, so a reader who has the Release and not a checkout cannot follow it, which is most readers of a Release. The fix is to emit a full https URL to the runbook at the tag in the notes. It rides the next cut and its own review rather than being changed now: release.yml was settled by the rv331-ward188c review and the 0.1.0 cut, and editing the generator between cuts would make the next set of notes differ from the ones this release actually has, so the change belongs where its output can be read once and checked.

Note on where the docs prose lives, for whoever does criterion 2: the verification specialist profile (.lore/agents/verification.toml) sits at its exact 20000-token budget, and the change that recorded the 0.1.0 gate results pushed it to roughly 20003 before the prose was compressed. Any further prose added to docs/security-tests.md must RE-HOME a source to another profile that can hold it, not trim the text again: node scripts/check-lore-agent-sources.mjs fails if a concept ends up in no profile, and raising max_tokens is forbidden. Both capacity gates went red on that change; check both after every edit.

Rides the same cut as WCLI-92 (the lean plugin root, DEC-246 (a4)); the two are independent changes.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The repository root carries a README.md that names the released version, gives the install command, and links docs/runbooks/install-and-upgrade-ward-from-a-release.md.
The Release notes generated by .github/workflows/release.yml carry a full https URL to the install runbook at the tag, so the Release page is self-sufficient without a checkout.
The docs change that adds the README keeps lore check and lore validate --strict at exit 0, and any added prose to a bundle concept re-homes an agent-profile source rather than trimming text.
